subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should the CI/security owners approve these 13 action revisions as one grouped upgrade after final-head gates, or split the Codex, token, scanning, and release pins into separately reviewed updates?
rationale: These are executable supply-chain changes crossing multiple secret and publishing boundaries; patch mechanics alone cannot authorize the new trusted revisions.

options.title: Approve grouped upgrade
options.body: Rebase to current main, keep the head stable, verify upstream diffs and representative workflow gates, then approve the grouped immutable pins.

options.title: Split sensitive families
options.body: Separate Codex, application-token, CodeQL, and Docker publishing actions so each owner can review and validate a smaller trust boundary.

options.title: Pause for bot recovery
options.body: Leave the PR open without approval until Dependabot can maintain the branch and produce a stable current-main head.

recommendation.title: Approve grouped upgrade
recommendation.body: Rebase to current main, keep the head stable, verify upstream diffs and representative workflow gates, then approve the grouped immutable pins.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest explicit owner evidence is CODEOWNERS coverage of the changed security scanning and dependency-guard workflow surfaces.
